text:
Evelyn Hart: Hey team — putting in paperwork for adoption leave starting May 15. I have three questions: is the $5k adoption stipend eligible for international adoptions? what's required for travel reimbursement? and what documents do benefits/payroll need for proof?

People Ops (bot): Checklist: Adoption stipend and travel reimbursements require (1) approved Adoption Leave Request, (2) adoption placement paperwork or embassy letter, and (3) expense receipts for travel reimbursements. See internal guide: https://intra.redwood.com/benefits/adoption-policy

Samir Khan: congrats! :tada: Short answers: yes, the adoption stipend covers international adoptions, but it requires the adoption placement confirmation + final adoption decree (or equivalent embassy/consulate documentation). Travel reimbursements are paid after expense submission and use payroll code TRVL-ADOPT.

Nina Flores (Legal): For international adoptions we accept an official placement letter from the adoption agency or the country's competent authority. If a visa petition is part of the process (e.g., IR-3/IR-4), include the USCIS receipt or embassy acknowledgement. Redact any sensitive child data when emailing.

Evelyn Hart: good to know. is there a deadline for submitting the adoption stipend paperwork?

People Ops (bot): Deadline: submit Adoption_Stipend_Claim_2025.pdf within 90 days of final adoption paperwork to benefits@redwood.com. Travel receipts must be submitted within 60 days of return.

Payroll Bot: Auto-reply: adoption stipend uses payroll code ADOPT-STIP and is treated as a non-taxable reimbursement up to plan limits when proper receipts and legal docs are provided. Travel reimbursements use TRVL-ADOPT. Include bank details if you prefer direct deposit to a personal travel card.

Samir Khan: workflow: 1) file the Adoption Leave Request (linked in the benefits guide), 2) attach placement docs to benefits@redwood.com, 3) for travel reimbursements upload receipts to the expense portal and tag TRVL-ADOPT, 4) cc payroll@redwood.com for faster processing.

Evelyn Hart: i'm doing this while on partial company-paid leave plus state leave—do I need separate state forms?

Nina Flores (Legal): depends on your state. If you're claiming state family leave benefits or paid family leave (e.g., CA-PFL), file with the state portal separately; include Redwood's employer details (we can provide a benefits verification letter). People Ops can prep that letter once your leave is approved.

Jordan Park: coverage note: Evelyn pls add a short hiring handoff for the senior backend role (candidates, next steps, offer authority). i'll cover interviews from May 1-30. also add a calendar block for a 20-min triage before your leave.

Evelyn Hart: will do. last Q — will the adoption stipend affect my benefits eligibility or insurance for the child before immigration is complete?

Samir Khan: benefits-wise, dependents can be added once you have proof of placement or legal guardianship; if the child isn't yet eligible for immigration benefits, we can add them provisionally with placement docs and then update once visa/decree finalizes. Benefits team will walk you through the dependent enrollment form.

People Ops (bot): Action items: submit Adoption Leave Request + Adoption_Stipend_Claim_2025.pdf to benefits@redwood.com by 1763503200 to keep processing smooth. People Ops will generate an employer verification letter after approval.

Evelyn Hart: thanks everyone — i'll submit the forms today and ping if we need the verification letter earlier. appreciate the help! :heart:
